title: Sautela Bhai
desc: Tulsiram is a village teacher who is married to Saraswati and has a step-brother, Rajaram, who lives in Bombay. When Rajaram returns, Tulsiram wants him to marry someone he has chosen but he has already chosen a wife.

title: Kirayadar
desc: Laxmi Abhyankar and her employed daughter Jaya live on rent in a flat on Pali Hill, Mumbai they rented years ago from Lucknow-based Kundanlal Choudhury. His son Anil comes to Mumbai and gets a job.

title: Lal Badshah
desc: A man who got separated from his biological parents at birth, grows up to become the voice of the people. His caring nature for others, eventually leads him on a dangerous journey to uncover the truth about who his real parents are.

title: Do Waqt Ki Roti
desc: When a notorious criminal breaks out of prison, Jailer Vijay resigns and vows to arrest him. However, Shankar, a brother set on avenging his sister's death, stands in Vijay's way.

title: Ghar Jamai
desc: Dwarka, a millionaire, is impressed by Anil, a principled man, and wants him to marry Mona, his daughter. However, after their marriage, he compels him to move into his house.
